factor_name: Exponentially Smoothed Multi-Horizon Volatility-Normalized Residual Reversal

calculation.expression: EWMA(span=4)[sum_h w_h * clip(-(return_h(lagged)/cross_sectional_mean_adjusted)/(rolling_std(return,60,lagged)*sqrt(h)), -5, 5)] for h in {10,20,40} with w={0.30,0.40,0.30}
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, calculate lagged 10-, 20-, and 40-session returns, remove the same-day cross-sectional mean to form residual returns, negate and divide by lagged 60-session volatility scaled by sqrt(h), clip each component, combine across horizons, then exponentially smooth the composite signal over four observations. Higher values indicate stronger expected relative forward returns. All inputs are lagged completed sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample signal is weak at 5 and 10 sessions but positive and above admission thresholds at 20 sessions; recent shorter-horizon performance is stronger. Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
validation.lookahead_control: Signals use shifted returns, shifted volatility, and completed-session prices only; forward returns are used solely for validation.
